about: Macrodantin (nitrofurantoin) 50 mg, 56 capsules at four a day (14 days), is supplied in March and again in May 2026, by brand name only.
Nitrofurantoin 50 mg at night is supplied monthly from January to April 2026, about four months of continuous use, in the middle of a 16-month history.
Two short Macrodantin courses (5 days in November 2025 and 6 days in April 2026) are supplied about five months apart, so neither course runs longer than a week.
